mechanism.claim: During joint BTC BVOL and DVOL expansion, an unusually large first-half Binance BTCUSDT premium-index move followed by a larger same-direction second-half move identifies accelerating derivatives demand before it is fully transmitted to BTC; the premium direction should relay for six hours.
mechanism.side: common sign of the two completed half-hour premium-index close-minus-open moves
mechanism.why_distinct: PVIAR uses a completed one-hour premium path and joint cross-venue volatility ignition. PCBR required a two-hour compressed premium cage and a ten-minute outside breakout; PSR required alternating high-energy premium motion that recentered. PVIAR uses neither compression nor recentering.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: premium-index intrahour acceleration fused with BVOL/DVOL ignition is absent from Gross9

clock.decision: T after a completed UTC hour
clock.premium_source: 60 exact bars_binance_premium BTCUSDT interval=1m rows in [T-1h,T), split offsets 0..29 and 30..59
clock.premium_moves: first_half_close-hour_open and hour_close-second_half_open; differences, not ratios, because premium can cross zero
clock.first_half_shock: nonzero absolute first-half move >= strictly-prior 720h q60 with 672 valid observations
clock.directional_acceleration: second-half move has same nonzero sign and absolute magnitude >= first-half absolute magnitude
clock.volatility_ignition: normalized completed-hour BVOL and DVOL bodies are both strictly positive
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset with prior source-valid consecutive hour
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.volatility: reuse hash-bound OCDR-12C BVOL/DVOL snapshot through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
